scope: Measured in one simulator and map. Historical and fresh cohorts are specified separately. No automatic deployment.

temporal_confirmations.scope: Retrospective RGB-only confirmation analysis. First label initializes the state; after that, require K consecutive raw labels before changing it. Report the full fixed set of K; no model selection or runtime change. Confirmed accuracy includes all stable 20-second post-ack segments.

audit_reproduction.replay_notes: 64 audit sampling seeds, identical eligible captured pixels and priority score, no independent new drives

relative_queue_parity.models: historical 824-row RF, its verified centers; separate from the spatial 1728-row comparative study

enriched_night.site_design: 23 targeted calibration poses in 3 site families and 15 evaluation poses in 4 different families; same simulator. Includes reference sites.

moving_depth_codes.scope: Post-hoc localization on 12 same-route laps. Pooled pixel IoU for each depth-code band; no physical distance calibration. Every frame reproduces original paired TP/FP/FN.

fresh_f1_largest_error.rule: Highest absolute refreshed f1 RF error among all defined fresh held images, selected after evaluation. Original 4-frame model batch and per-pixel target are verified.

frozen_alarm_road_link_transfer.method: Supplementary evaluation of previously frozen f0 spatial RF thresholds. Study location selection used road geometry. Labels in other analyses were opened before this follow-up was chosen.
